title: docs(v3): add migration guide to menus
body:

* Remove the "Prepare for v3" guide

## Guide

comments.body:
Deploy preview for *instantsearchjs* ready!

Built with commit 0d006900eb6e1414203e04750920ad707090d755

https://deploy-preview-3280--instantsearchjs.netlify.com
should be called something in sync with the `migrate from V1` title IMO and those things together in the menu.
Actually "Migrate from v1" doesn't make sense in the v3 documentation, we should remove it.

I don't think we should remove the migration guide from v1 to v2. We still have users on support asking about question on the v1 of InstantSearch. We don't "support" the v1 but people might want to upgrade from v1.
@samouss I meant exclusively on the v3 website.
I think even then the guide should still exist actually, there are still v1 -> v2 -> v3 use cases (e.g. shopify)

@Haroenv In this case, wouldn't it make sense for users to follow this?

1. go on the v1 website and follow the guide: "Migrate to v2"
1. go on the v2 website and follow the guide: "Migrate to v3"

We don't plan to write a guide v1 → v3 directly.
